packs.title: Ridges, Museums and Harbor
packs.promise: Explore New Haven's hills, collections, neighborhood parks and harbor across separate outings.

q.s: Choose an honest route to a public ridge viewpoint without requiring the Giant Steps.
st: Find the summit and at least one lawful approach on the city park map.
Mark a safe arrival or turnaround and note whether your choice involves a climb.
Record a route plan that does not promise vehicle access or clear views in poor weather.

q.s: Use one museum collection item to make a carefully sourced New Haven history note.
st: Choose one collection item or online exhibition connected to the city.
Record what the operator actually identifies about its date, maker or use.
Write one observation and one sourced context sentence without stretching a single object into the whole city's history.

q.s: Plan a short open park segment while avoiding the closed mid-bridge trail.
st: Use the city's sensory-trail description to choose an open northern or southern segment.
Identify one interpretation plaque or pond relation without crossing the closed mid-bridge trail.
Record a short out-and-back with an accessible turnaround or official-map alternative.

packs.title: Green to Yale
packs.promise: Follow a compact public route from the Green to Yale's library and museums.

q.s: Trace how open Green paths meet the surrounding downtown streets.
st: Choose two public Green edges from the city map or on site.
Trace a lawful path between them and identify the street crossing needed to continue downtown.
Record a small route sketch with the path and street labeled separately.

q.s: Plan one public library use without needing a card or a scheduled program.
st: Find the Main Library's Elm Street location in its branch guide.
Choose one open public area or visitor service described by the library.
Record a two-step visit plan with current hours checked from the operator.

q.s: Keep what you see in one artwork separate from its museum label or record.
st: Choose one work in an open permanent gallery or official collection record.
Describe one visible form, material or arrangement without inventing intent.
Record a separate maker, date or context point credited to the gallery.
